body:
## `Fixes #3748` and pin 1

The review notes that `Fixes #3748` closes an issue whose first pin is `start_side_pass_has_no_helix_or_ramp`: Inside and Outside on the dog-bone part and on `fig8.step` have no helix move and no ramp move below the material top.

This PR keeps a user-selected Helix, Ramp or Plunge and warns. That is the maintainer's rule, and it is right. The question is only the close: with a selected Ramp, a ramp move below the material top exists, so pin 1 as written is not met in that configuration.

The Arc clause is not the problem: #3843 is CLOSED and its fix #3858 is on `main`, so a new operation seeds the Arc entry and the default no longer makes a helix.

Before this PR merges, do one of these:
1. change the body line to `Refs #3748`, and close #3748 when its pins are green in the seeded configuration, or
2. add one sentence to #3748 that pin 1 covers the automatic entry only, and an explicitly selected Ramp is allowed with its warning. Then `Fixes #3748` is true.

The rest of the review is `merge-ready`.

Ready to merge. Class: SAME. The merge relies on the review at `abfaf7884` (no blocker): offset_pass_start 9/0, and the P1 heavy step `offset_pass_start`, on the trial merge with main `16115cd06`. Main moved after that only by #3870 (test-only) and #3878 (the gpu crate). `git merge-tree` with `aedd9750c` is clean. `Fixes #3748` stays: the one remaining part, Arc as the default for a new operation, is tracked in #3843 (P1).

<!-- pr-reviewer: abfaf78844edd5d9fa9c85060da3bdc762a7f291 -->
**Verdict: blockers found after the merge.** The PR merged at `1fe369fab` before this review ended. A plain Outside pocket still has the automatic dead-end ramp, and it plunges with no warning at a dead end. The findings are below. This comment sets no label.

## Blockers (these behaviours are on main now)

**Class: a stand-in entry, or a selected non-Arc entry, on a "Pass starts at" Inside or Outside pass does not give a warning.** One rule must close the class: each entry on an Inside or Outside pass that is not the selected Arc posts a `Warning`, or shows a line on the op page status. This includes each named stand-in and each selected Helix, Ramp or Plunge. The air room must not be the gate.

1. **The dead-end ramp is still on a plain Outside pocket with Arc selected.** I ran a local probe on the #3567 band (`pocket_started(..., PassStart::Outside)`, no stock known, D8, stepover 4). With Arc selected, the PR head gives 8 notes of the form `entry: the pass start (10.246, 16.000) at Z -3.000 is in material and the arc's lead room is blocked - ramp along the pass instead`. The later entries cut 1411.06 mm² of uncut stock. This is the same value as on main before the PR. The ramp now comes from `descent_dive::entry_restart` -> `ramp_fallback`, through `ladder_links.rs::pass_link`, and not from `dead_end_ramp`. Thus decision item 4 ("A later pass that no lead-in reaches now takes the pass link's entry, which is the user's") is not correct for Arc. The selected Ramp gives the same path.
2. **These stand-ins are not shown as warnings.** `approach_page::entry_status_lines` (`crates/ui/src/egui_app/approach_page.rs:239-266`) shows an `entry:` note only when it contains "axial dive", "second dive", "fits nowhere" and similar words. I ran a local probe on the strings that the code makes. Each of these gives no status line and no `Warning`:
   - `... - ramp along the pass instead` (`descent_dive.rs:272`)
   - `... - plunged into material at the plunge feed` (`descent_dive.rs:284`)
   - `entry: Outside pass - no air entry outside the stock box fits (...) - helix entry instead` and `- ramp along the first cut instead` (`air_entry.rs:241-247`)

   The maintainer's words on #3748: "it uses a safe entry and names it in a warning". A note in `path.notes` only is not a warning on the op page.
3. **A plain Outside pocket with Plunge selected plunges 9 times into uncut stock, with no note and no warning.** On the same band, the PR head gives 9 plunges below the top and a 204.12 mm² late-entry cut, and the notes have no entry line. On main, the same case gave a named ramp. The selected Plunge is the user's choice, but the #3748 rule says that the op "also gives a warning on the operation and in the status line". `entry_advice_note` is written only where `AirRoom::for_side` is `Some` (`pocket.rs:340-348`, `pocket_avoid.rs:256-271`). Thus a pocket area with Inside or Outside gets no warning. The Lead in page shows the advice for that area, but the op posts nothing (the decision file records this, under "Dropped").
4. **Pins 2 and 3 do not pin the change.** I ran them on main's `crates/motion/src` with the PR's test file (pin 1 removed, because it needs the new API). `the_arc_entry_has_no_helix_or_ramp_and_no_advice` and `start_side_pass_has_no_automatic_ramp` both pass on main. They test the band round a part with the stock known, where #3744 had already stopped the ramp. Only `a_short_dead_end_no_longer_falls_back_to_auto` is red on main. The pocket form lost its late-entry pin: `outside_entries_after_the_first_land_in_cleared_stock` now runs only round a part. Add a red-first pin on the pocket form: Arc gives no ramp along the pass, or a warning that names it; Plunge gives one warning.

## What looks good
- One sentence of advice, `sim::verify::entry_advice`. It names the side, the selected type, Arc and the reason in plain English. `EntryNotRecommended` is advisory, and MCP has `entry_not_recommended`.
- `entry_not_recommended` gives at most one warning for each op. The `entry:` advice note does not show as a second status line.
- Round a part (stock known), the selected Helix, Ramp and Plunge run and are named one time. Arc gives no helix, no ramp and no advice there.
- The Lead in page greys nothing out. `the_leads_tab_advises_arc_next_to_the_entry_type_for_inside_and_outside` asserts the advice label and an enabled Type combo. The `#[test]` count of `crates/ui` goes up by one, and no UI test is removed.
- The new app test joins the `offset_pass_start` directory suite.

## Results (local, trial merge of `abfaf7884` with `origin/main` `9046e1dc8`)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main` (`CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6`) | 385 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled (83.0 min). This includes `motion: pass_start_engagement`, `app: offset_pass_start`, `app: adaptive_pass_start` and `ui: lib` |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo xtask gate heavy --only "app heavy: offset_pass_start"` (release) | ok, 891 s |
| Pins 2 and 3 on main's motion source | both pass on main (they are not red first) |
| Local probe, plain Outside pocket (band, no stock) | Arc: 8 named ramps, 1411.06 mm², no status line. Plunge: 9 plunges, no note |

The merged tree `1fe369fab` is different from my trial tree in 10 files only (`crates/gpu`, one `pass_start_levels` test, two decision files). It has no change in the entry code.

## Notes (not blocking)
- #3746 is open again for its pin 5. The PR body does not say if #3748 replaces that pin. A comment on #3746 must close that question.
- Pin 1 and the app tests check Outside only. Inside has no op-level advice test.
- These files were already over 400 lines and got larger: `operation/generate.rs`, `sim/verify/types.rs`, `ui/operations.rs`, `ui/kind_editors.rs`, `mcp/job.rs`.

A maintainer decides the follow-up. The coordinator files the P1 for the blockers.
